name: ai-compare-project
description: Runs both tool-profile-api and compare-api together with one command.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix tool-profile-api && npm install --prefix compare-api
scripts.start: node api.js && concurrently -n TOOL-PROFILE,COMPARE -c blue,green "npm start --prefix tool-profile-api" "npm start --prefix compare-api"
